Evidence:
[1] Liongoren co-wrote the screenplay with Charlene Sawit-Esguerra and Carlo Ledesma, based on a short story written by Sawit-Esguerra in 2002, which was then entitled as "Monster Town".
[2] It is the first episode of a two-part story written by showrunner Steven Moffat and directed by Adam Smith; the second episode was "Flesh and Stone".
[3] Steven Moffat, their creator, attributes their appeal to childhood games such as Grandmother's Footsteps and the notion that every statue might secretly be a disguised Weeping Angel.
[4] "The Time of the Doctor" is an episode of the British science fiction television programme "Doctor Who", written by Steven Moffat and directed by Jamie Payne, and was broadcast as the ninth "Doctor Who" Christmas special on 25 December 2013 on BBC One.

Notes:
[bridge] The short story 'What I Did on My Christmas Holidays' By Sally Sparrow was adapted into the Doctor Who episode 'Blink'.
